name: stol-sweep
note: The sustained shape on the fourth ONE-LAW airframe. deriveAzRate asks for the same FRACTION of structural g on a trainer as on a jet, so this is directly comparable to fixedwing-sweep in normalized terms (turnRateDemandRatio, terminalOffDeg/demand) and to nothing in absolute deg/s. Distinct tag from turn360 on purpose: compare-runs.py pools by tag alone. AIRFRAME: low-limit STOL trainer (alphaLimiter ~10 deg). A jet placed at 90 m/s will mush - see cards/README.md. TWO DEFECTS FIXED, both of which invalidated a whole session; read before comparing against any capture taken before this edit. (1) THE CARD NEVER FLEW SLOW. startSpeed is applied ONCE at the placement and nothing holds it: with throttle unpinned the batch ran at 1.00 and the jets were at 144-147 m/s by the end of the 6 s arm and 340-381 m/s (2.1-2.4x corner) by the last scored segment - FASTER than anything else in the run, on a card whose entire purpose is low q. Only COIN (104 m/s mean) actually flew it. ScenarioThrottle is now pinned at 0.25. That number is derived, not chosen: 90 -> 145.5 m/s in 6 s is a mean specific excess thrust of 9.25 m/s2, level-flight drag at 90 m/s is about g/(L/D) ~ 0.98 m/s2, so full-throttle T/m ~ 10.2 m/s2 and holding 90 m/s needs about 0.10 throttle. THE MOD WILL NOT ACCEPT THAT: EntryThrottle snaps anything below MinThrottle 0.25 (ScenarioPlayer.cs:1365) back to the 0.70 DEFAULT, so pinning 0.10 would fly at 0.70 and be worse than doing nothing. 0.25 is therefore a FLOOR, not an optimum, and it leaves about +1.6 m/s2 of residual excess (~+57 m/s over this card's 36 s). CHECK spd AT THE END OF THE ARM ON THE FIRST CAPTURE: if it is still above ~120 m/s the throttle lever is exhausted and the remaining fix is mod-side (MinThrottle), not a card edit. (2) THE ALTITUDE DID NOT COVER THE MANEUVER. Nine of ten lanes hit 'abort: altitude floor (500 m MSL)' 19-26 s into replicate 1; all 13 captures lost 1846-1963 m, and COIN only survived by ending at 580 m descending 75 m/s. startAlt 2500 left just 2000 m of usable air. Sized from those measurements rather than rounded up: worst measured mean sink is 1963 m / 19 s = 103 m/s, and every one of those captures was TRUNCATED by the floor, so the full 36 s cost is at least 36 x 103 = 3719 m. 6000 m clears that with 1781 m still above the floor, and it is corroborated rather than guessed - R27's sweep-lowq is the IDENTICAL 36 s deriveAzRate shape at 6000 m and took 0 aborts in 32. Pinning the throttle down also removes the thrust that was previously masking the descent, so the altitude had to be sized for the FIXED card, not the flown one. KNOWN LIMIT, not fixed here: RateMaxDegS = 30 clips 4 of 10 derived sweep rates, so this card's 'same fraction of structural g on every airframe' premise is FALSE on those four lanes - check the derived rate in the '[card] suite start' line before making any cross-airframe claim.
